gitignored/local-only; caused 2 stray promotes today". The report was accurate
as sent; the mechanism below is this ticket's own survey, and the 0-vs-6
measurement was taken on the live tree while the pause was active.
Approval context: Firm, and measured rather than reasoned: with the pause marker that is active right now, `effective_backlog_depth_cli.bb` prints 0 for the master checkout and 6 for `.worktrees/coder`. Both promotion entry points (`promote_and_route_next.sh`, `route_backlog_to_coder.sh`) derive their root from `git…
